const cmds = [
  {
    cmd: `python3 -B -c 'import json,pathlib,re,subprocess,sys
root=pathlib.Path.cwd()
sys.path.insert(0,str(root/"tools"))
from i18nlib.config import load_manifest
from i18nlib.locale_model import LocaleLoader
from i18nlib.runtime import LuaRuntime
loader=LocaleLoader(LuaRuntime(load_manifest(version="tome-1.7.6",manifest_path=None)))
p=root/"tome-ashes-urhrok.lua"
cur=loader.load_bytes(p.read_bytes(),logical_path=p.name).translations
old=loader.load_bytes(subprocess.check_output(["git","show","HEAD:tome-ashes-urhrok.lua"]),logical_path=p.name).translations
ws=json.loads((root/".ai/task/repair-w30-20260925/WORKSET.json").read_text())["items"]
fields=("function_name","kind","section","source","source_tag","args_order","special")
sem=lambda r: tuple(r.get(k) for k in fields)+(r.get("target"),)
changed=[(i,b,a) for i,(b,a) in enumerate(zip(old,cur)) if sem(b)!=sem(a)]
wk={(x["section"],x["source"],x.get("source_tag")) for x in ws}
ck={(a["section"],a["source"],a.get("source_tag")) for i,b,a in changed}
ids={(x["section"],x["source"],x.get("source_tag")):x["entry_revision_identity"] for x in ws}
non_target=[{"revision":ids.get((a["section"],a["source"],a.get("source_tag")),"outside"),"field":k} for i,b,a in changed for k in fields if b.get(k)!=a.get(k)]
preimage_bad=[x["entry_revision_identity"] for x in ws if not any(b["section"]==x["section"] and b["source"]==x["source"] and b.get("source_tag")==x.get("source_tag") and b["target"]==x["target_preimage"] for b in old)]
lf_bad=[ids[(a["section"],a["source"],a.get("source_tag"))] for i,b,a in changed if a["source"].count("\\n")!=a["target"].count("\\n")]
tabs=lambda s:[len(z)-len(z.lstrip("\\t")) for z in s.split("\\n")]
tab_bad=[ids[(a["section"],a["source"],a.get("source_tag"))] for i,b,a in changed if tabs(a["source"])!=tabs(a["target"])]
rev="ce3b54895d49edbdf483d73d8901a370ad0c2e32121ab624a1863edd3fc77c8d"
target=next(a["target"] for i,b,a in changed if ids[(a["section"],a["source"],a.get("source_tag"))]==rev)
ph="<?=_t(player.descriptor.subrace, \\"birth descriptor name\\")?>"
exact=(target.count(ph)==4 and "另一个"+ph+"站在相同的平台上" in target and "扑到"+ph+"脸上" in target and ph+"脸上的笑容消失了" in target and ph+"停止扭动" in target)
out={"loader":"LuaJIT via LocaleLoader","records_before":len(old),"records_after":len(cur),"changed_targets":len(changed),"workset_items":len(ws),"non_target_field_changes":non_target,"workset_missing_from_diff":len(wk-ck),"diff_outside_workset":len(ck-wk),"preimage_mismatches":preimage_bad,"lf_mismatches":lf_bad,"leading_tab_mismatches":tab_bad,"ce3b_placeholder_count":target.count(ph),"ce3b_exact_positions":exact}
print(json.dumps(out,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
ok=len(old)==len(cur)==849 and len(changed)==len(ws)==23 and not any((non_target,wk-ck,ck-wk,preimage_bad,lf_bad,tab_bad)) and exact
raise SystemExit(0 if ok else 1)'`,
    workdir: "/workspace/tome4-chinese-translation",
    yield_time_ms: 30000,
    max_output_tokens: 12000,
    sandbox_permissions: "require_escalated",
    justification: "允许我运行只读 LuaJIT LocaleLoader 全量语义比对，确认相对 HEAD 恰 23 条冻结 target 变化并专项核验四处占位符吗？"
  },
  {
    cmd: "python3 -B tools/i18n lint --strict",
    workdir: "/workspace/tome4-chinese-translation",
    yield_time_ms: 30000,
    max_output_tokens: 12000,
    sandbox_permissions: "require_escalated",
    justification: "允许我运行要求的严格 i18n lint 验证最终译文吗？",
    prefix_rule: ["python3","-B","tools/i18n","lint"]
  },
  {
    cmd: "git diff --check -- tome-ashes-urhrok.lua",
    workdir: "/workspace/tome4-chinese-translation",
    yield_time_ms: 30000,
    max_output_tokens: 5000,
    sandbox_permissions: "require_escalated",
    justification: "允许我运行要求的目标文件 git diff 空白检查吗？",
    prefix_rule: ["git","diff","--check"]
  }
];
const results = await Promise.all(cmds.map(c => tools.exec_command(c)));
results.forEach((r,i)=>text(`CHECK ${i+1}\n${r.output}\nexit=${r.exit_code}`));
